headline: Approved site plan and special permit for five-unit townhouse project at 46 Federal Street
summary: The Planning Board held a public hearing on Site Plan Review #170-26 and Special Permit #205-26 for 46 Federal Street, a project to demolish an existing dwelling and build five townhouse units with reduced parking aisle width. The Board made required special permit findings, then approved the special permit and site plan review with conditions from the Parking & Traffic Commission, Design Review Board, Board of Health, and Engineering Department. The Board also approved the April 7, 2026 meeting minutes as amended.
decisions: Approved Special Permit #205-26 findings for 46 Federal Street, 6-0.
Approved Special Permit #205-26 for 46 Federal Street subject to Conditions #1, 2, and 3 from the Parking & Traffic Commission's recommendation letter dated April 28, 2026, 6-0.
Approved Site Plan Review #170-26 for 46 Federal Street incorporating conditions from the Design Review Board, Board of Health, and Engineering Department, 6-0.
Approved the April 7, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended, 6-0.
